text:
Type: wingback armchair
Use: relaxing, reading; living room, library, bedroom
Style: traditional, classic, retro
Materials: woven fabric upholstery with button tufting, padded frame, solid wood tapered legs
Colors: olive green, light brown wood
Shape: tall back with flared wings, button-tufted backrest, scrolled rolled arms, thick seat cushion with piping, four tapered wooden legs, upright and generous, medium visual weight
Feel: cozy, classic, inviting, cheerful
Goes with: warm wood, cream or white walls, brass lamps, patterned rugs; traditional or classic living rooms, reading corners

product.name: STRANDMON
product.description: You can really loosen up and relax in comfort because the high back on this chair provides extra support for your neck.
